decision.selected_method: independent full native replay of the saved central_high schedule

decision.hypothesis: The immediate physical uncertainty is whether the near-feasible sampled native prediction for central_high survives an independent complete replay with dense original checks. Competing hypotheses are: H1, the small predicted channel-3 tendon-speed excess is a search/sampling artifact and the saved schedule satisfies every frozen central_high constraint; H2, the excess is physically realized, so the schedule fails the unchanged 0.025 m/s tendon-speed limit despite meeting the reach/hold bounds. T01-126 reports best sampled J=0.001987557745892543, holding error 0.009992326387509454 m, holding tip speed 0.02996585727332516 m/s, and channel 3 geometric tendon speed as the limiting constraint; T01-125 supplies the current-candidate control lineage but no acceptance measurement.
decision.expected_observation: Under H2, independent full replay of the exact T01-126 schedule will reproduce a small dense-grid geometric tendon-speed violation, most likely on channel 3 near 0.025 m/s, while holding position error remains at or below 0.01 m and holding tip speed remains at or below 0.03 m/s. This would establish failure only for this schedule and central_high, not structural infeasibility.
decision.weakening_observation: H2 is refuted, and H1 supported for central_high, if the independent replay completes without numerical failure and every physics-state check passes: all tensions remain within 0–8 N, every tendon stays within ±0.015 m stroke from its complete initial length, every tendon speed is at most 0.025 m/s, and holding-window position error and tip speed are at most 0.01 m and 0.03 m/s respectively. A materially different failing constraint would also weaken the specific channel-3 hypothesis and redirect diagnosis.
decision.fixed_conditions: Hold the frozen T01 task, central_high target [0.295,0,0.215] m, zero initializer, shared candidate structure, gravity, rigid payload, 0.001 s physics timestep, 0.02 s control/sample period, 0.6 s duration, holding window [0.54,0.6] s, exact saved schedule, six independent channels, and all original acceptance thresholds fixed. This decision does not evaluate negative_low or positive_high and cannot establish joint three-condition acceptance.
decision.stopping_condition: Stop after one independent complete central_high replay and inspect its exact registered result. Do not select the candidate unless separate independent passing replays subsequently exist for all three required frozen conditions.
decision.interpretation: This is the narrowest feasible discriminator because T01-126 is only a sampled native numerical diagnostic and explicitly requires independent full replay; it is not complete task acceptance, geometry validation, or a global feasibility result. A pass resolves schedule-level central_high uncertainty only. A failure motivates control revision rather than a structural-infeasibility claim.
